name: How long does a project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timelines vary depending on scope, but most projects ship in 4–8 weeks — from discovery to launch. You'll always get a detailed schedule before we start, with clear milestones and review points.

name: Do you only work on websites?

acceptedAnswer.text: No — we act as your extended in-house digital team. That covers strategy, UX/UI design, branding, development, audits and ongoing optimization. We adapt to your tools, pace and goals like a dedicated internal department, with outside perspective.

name: How do you handle NDAs and client privacy?

acceptedAnswer.text: Discretion is the default. We're happy to sign an NDA before any project conversation. All project data, assets and communications are handled securely so your ideas, strategy and tech stay private at every stage.
Flexible pricing — fixed quotes for defined scopes, hourly for agile work, and retainers for ongoing partnerships. Every estimate is transparent and tailored to what you actually need.

name: Can you redesign or improve our existing website?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. Many of our clients arrive with an existing site. We audit performance, tighten the design system, improve conversion and streamline the user journey — without throwing away what's already working.

name: What if we're not sure what we need yet?

acceptedAnswer.text: That's exactly what the discovery call is for. We'll dig into your goals, surface the real problems and outline the best next steps — even if that means a smaller, simpler scope than you expected.
